content: यदृच्छा [यद् ऋच्छ्-अ टाप् <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 Acting as one likes, self-will, independence (of action); यदृच्छयासुयति यस्तपस्यते <ls>Ki. 14. 21</ls>. .²2 Chance, accident; usually used in the instrumental singular in this sense and translated by ‘accidentally’, ‘by chance’; किन्नरमिथुनं यदृच्छयाऽद्राक्षीत् <ls>K.</ls> ‘chanced or happened to see’ <ab>&c.</ab>; वसिष्ठधेनुश्च यदृच्छयाऽऽगता श्रुतप्रभावा ददृशेऽथ नन्दिनी <ls>R. 3. 40</ls>; <ls>V. 1. 10</ls>; <ls>Ku. 1. 14</ls>; <ls>U. 5. 16</ls>.
